title: Darwaze ka handle KINAARE pe kyun hota hai?
description: Season 2 Episode 18: Turning needs torque = force × distance from the pivot; more distance, less effort.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 6 (torque τ = r × F, moment arm)
hook_text: Darwaze ka handle beech mein kyun nahi hota? 🚪
concept: Turning needs torque = force × distance from the pivot; more distance, less effort.
on_screen_cues: door: force near hinge (big arrow, no move) vs at handle (small arrow, opens) → "τ = r × F" → "Same torque: r ↑ ⇒ F ↓" → seesaw → "NCERT XI Ch 6"
pinned_comment: Kainchi se moti cheez kaatni hai — blade ke TIP se ya andar se? Kyun? ✂️
suggested_titles: "Darwaze ka handle kinaare pe kyun hota hai?" / "Torque kya hai? Seesaw pe papa ko kaise uthaye"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, darwaze ka handle hamesha kinaare pe kyun hota hai? Beech mein kyun nahi?
Chintu: [mischievously] Ek baar hinge ke bilkul paas se darwaza kholne ki koshish karo.
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Bahut zor lagta hai... almost khulta hi nahi!
Chintu: [excited] Aur kinaare se?
Gudiya: [cheerfully] Ek ungli se khul jaata hai!
Chintu: [elated] Wahi! Ghumaane ke liye sirf FORCE nahi chahiye... force into DISTANCE chahiye. Isko TORQUE bolte hain.
Gudiya: [curious] Distance kahan se?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Jahan se cheez ghoomti hai. Hinge se. Jitna door, utna zyada torque, utni kam mehnat!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Isliye lambe wrench se bolt aasaani se khulta hai?
Chintu: [excited] Exactly! Aur isliye seesaw pe halka bachcha bhi bhaari papa ko utha sakta hai... door baith ke!
Gudiya: [laughs] Toh distance, force ka multiplier hai!
Chintu: [proudly] Yahi rotation chapter ki pehli line hai. Torque equals r into F.
Gudiya: [curious] Bicycle ka pedal, steering wheel, kainchi, nut-bolt... sab isi pe?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Sab! Insaan 5000 saal se torque use kar raha hai... naam Newton ke baad diya.
Gudiya: [curious] Aur ice skater haath andar karke tez kyun ghoomti hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein! Usme ek earthquake bhi aayega.
